'''Solomon Alabi''' (born on March 3, 1988 in [[Kaduna]]) is a [[Nigeria]]n [[basketball]] player. He most recently played for [[Florida State University]].<ref name="seminoles1">{{cite web|url=http://www.seminoles.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/alabi_solomon00.html |title=Player Bio: Solomon Alabi |publisher=Seminoles.com |date= |accessdate=2010-06-11}}</ref>

==Early Life==
Alabi grew up in Kaduna, Nigeria before moving to [[Orlando, Florida]] at the age of 15. He attended [[high school]] at [[Montverde Academy]] in [[Montverde]], [[Florida]] where he was an all-state performer and helped lead Montverde Academy to a perfect 30-0 record during his senior season.<ref name="seminoles1"/>

==College Career==
After breaking his leg 10 games into his [[freshman]] year, Alabi had to take a medical [[redshirt]]. As a redshirt freshman, he earned All-[[ACC]] Freshman Team honors by averaging 8.4 points per game and leading the ACC in blocks with 2.1 per game. For his great shot-blocking ability, Alabi was named to the ACC All-Defensive team in [[2008]]-[[2009]].<ref name="seminoles1"/> As a redshirt [[sophomore]], Alabi ranked 26th in the nation in blocked shots with an average of 2.39 while increasing his scoring average to 11.7 points per game.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://espn.go.com/ncb/player/profile?playerId=36130 |title=Solomon Alabi Stats, News, Photos - Florida State Seminoles - ESPN |publisher=Espn.go.com |date= |accessdate=2010-06-11}}</ref> On [[April]] 23, 2010, Alabi declared himself eligible for the [[2010 NBA Draft]].<ref>[http://nbcsports.msnbc.com/id/36740549/ns/sports-college_basketball/ ]{{dead link|date=June 2010}}</ref> He is projected to be a mid to late first round draft pick.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/nba-mock-draft/2010/ |title=2010 Mock Draft |publisher=DraftExpress |date= |accessdate=2010-06-11}}</ref>
